name: Target Cursor
description: Custom cursor made of four rotating corner brackets and a center dot that snaps onto hovered targets, resizing to wrap them with spring motion, optional label, color change and click squeeze.
contents: Four corner bracket elements and a center dot rendered in a portal on document.body
Optional text label above the locked target, read from its data-cursor-label attribute
behavior: Brackets spin continuously around the pointer while not over a target
Over an element matching the target selector, brackets lock on, rotate to a quarter turn and resize to wrap it with padding
Slight parallax lean toward the pointer while locked
Press squeezes the brackets and shrinks the dot
Cursor color blends to the on-target color when locked
Fades in and out as the pointer enters or leaves the window or container
Spring physics driven by requestAnimationFrame that sleeps when idle
editableByProps: Which elements are targets via a CSS selector, and an optional restricting container
Colors, blend mode, bracket size, corner length, thickness, dot size and padding
Spin speed, snap speed, parallax, corner radius matching, label and click effect toggles
Whether the native cursor is hidden

needsCodeEdit.change: Change label font size or styling
needsCodeEdit.where: The labelRef span className in the returned portal

needsCodeEdit.change: Change spring feel while following the pointer
needsCodeEdit.where: The follow and followC constants inside the frame function
The squeeze constant in the frame function
The finePointer media query and the pointerType checks in the handlers

fixed: Renders nothing on touch or non-hover devices, so it has no effect on mobile and tablets
Attaches global pointer, scroll and blur listeners on window and injects a style tag into document.head
Hides the native cursor on the whole page (or container) with an important cursor rule while the pointer is inside
Overlay is fixed full screen at the maximum z-index and ignores pointer events
Target elements need the matching selector class (default cursor-target) and optional data-cursor-label attribute
Spin is disabled when the user prefers reduced motion
Label is fixed at 12px medium text
